title: Dress for the Weather
description: Students apply knowledge of weather conditions by dressing a character correctly for four different weather scenes (sunny/hot, cold/dry, rainy, windy).
creator: Health Education
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Health Education

learningObjectives: Students apply knowledge of weather conditions by dressing a character correctly for four different weather scenes (sunny/hot, cold/dry, rainy, windy).

pedagogical.instructionalRationale: Supports a Apply-level objective through direct interaction rather than passive reading.
